test_title: PYST 14: SSC MTS 2024 - General Awareness (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Which state received the Sportstar ACES Best State for the Promotion of Sport award in 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Sportstar ACES Awards recognize excellence in sports promotion and administration in India.
 
• Best State for the Promotion of Sport category.
 
• Winner 2024: Tamil Nadu, for outstanding initiatives in promoting sports at grassroots and professional levels.
 
• Highlights the state’s commitment to developing athletes, sports infrastructure, and encouraging participation in various sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kalinga Stadium**: Located in Bhubaneswar, it is a premier sports complex that has hosted numerous national and international sports events.
 
• **FIH Men's Hockey World Cup**: Odisha hosted the FIH Men's Hockey World Cup in 2018 and is set to host it again in 2023.
 
• **Grassroots Development**: Odisha's initiatives include sports training programs at the grassroots level to identify and nurture young talent.
 
• **Partnerships**: The state has collaborated with organizations like Hockey India and the Athletics Federation of India to promote various sports.
 
• **Investment in Sports**: Significant investments have been made in sports infrastructure, training facilities, and athlete welfare programs.
